title: Smashed Beef Kabob with Cucumber Yogurt
summary: Crispy, charred spiced beef with walnuts over cool cucumber-mint yogurt; great with pita or rice.
difficulty_reason: Mix two bowls and sear in one skillet; no tricky technique.

ingredients.line: 3 tbsp chopped fresh mint, plus leaves to serve
1 tsp salt, to season the yogurt
Warmed pita or cooked white rice, for serving

steps: Stir together the yogurt, grated cucumbers, chopped mint and grated garlic in a medium bowl. Chill until ready to serve.
In a separate bowl, mix the beef, grated onion, turmeric, 1 teaspoon salt and plenty of black pepper until well combined.
Heat a large, well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over medium-high until very hot.
Drop the beef into the pan in large, irregular chunks and cook undisturbed 6 to 8 minutes, until charred and crisp on the bottom.
Toss the meat with a wooden spoon, breaking up any extra-large pieces.
Stir in the walnuts and cranberries and cook 2 to 3 minutes more, until the meat is cooked through and the walnuts are toasted.
Season the chilled yogurt with the remaining 1 teaspoon salt and spread it across the bottom of a serving platter.
Pile the crispy meat on top and finish with pomegranate molasses and fresh mint. Serve with warm pita or rice.
tips: Let the beef sit undisturbed until it releases naturally from the pan; that is where the crisp crust comes from.
source_notes: Ingredients and method from the caption (NYT Cooking recipe by Zaynab Issa); the caption says raisins in the method but cranberries in the list and voiceover, so cranberries used.
